shared_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original finished fantasy RPG character portrait for OpenGold. Target 1024x1024 square or larger native square. One complete unified chest-up portrait, never separate head/body parts. Traditional hand-painted fantasy CRPG portrait aesthetic, realistic textured brushwork, rich restrained palette, soft warm key light and muted dark charcoal atmospheric background. Face large and readable as a small party icon, full top of head including horns within frame, shoulders visible, breathing room above head. All characters adults with individual faces and varied adult ages; fantasy anatomy must clearly communicate the species. Practical class clothing, no sexualized poses. Single individual only; no collage, panels, borders, text, watermark, logos or existing copyrighted characters. Original independently designed artwork, not derived from the screenshot or original game assets.
method: Built-in image_gen; individual generated assets, no compositing or duplication. Actual gender and appearance tags are authoring intent, not inferred identities.
